Test Scenario: Add a single item to Cart from catalog
Precondition: User is on Astronauts homepage or catalog with delivery location set.
Steps:
1. Browse products in catalog.
2. Click "+ Tambah" button on an available item.
3. Observe cart floating icon and bottom navigation counter.
Expected Result: Product is added to Cart. Cart counter increments by 1. Bottom cart notification banner appears.
Actual Result: Cart counter increments by 1; product stored in cart state.

Test Scenario: Add multiple different items to Cart
Precondition: Cart already contains 1 item.
Steps:
1. Browse to another category (e.g. Astro Cafe / Buah Segar).
2. Click "+ Tambah" on 2 different products.
3. Click "Keranjang" icon to view cart.
Expected Result: All 3 selected items appear in Cart with correct individual prices, quantities (1 each), and accurate subtotal.
Actual Result: All items displayed accurately with combined subtotal.

Test Scenario: Verify Cart Page UI components and layout
Precondition: Cart contains at least 1 item; user opens Cart page.
Steps:
1. Open Cart page (/cart).
2. Verify Header, "Tujuan Pengiriman", Items list, "Tambah Catatan", "Pilihan Promo", and "Ringkasan Pembayaran".
Expected Result: All sections are rendered cleanly with standard Astronauts theme, correct Indonesian labels, and Rupiah currency formatting.
Actual Result: UI layout is structured, responsive, and matches design specs.

Test Scenario: Increment item quantity in Cart
Precondition: Cart contains an item with quantity = 1.
Steps:
1. On Cart page, locate the item row.
2. Tap the "+" button once.
Expected Result: Quantity updates from 1 to 2. Item total price doubles. Subtotal in Ringkasan Pembayaran recalculates instantly.
Actual Result: Quantity increments to 2 and subtotal recalculates instantly.

Test Scenario: Decrement item quantity in Cart (above 1)
Precondition: Cart contains an item with quantity = 2.
Steps:
1. On Cart page, locate the item row.
2. Tap the "-" button once.
Expected Result: Quantity decreases from 2 to 1. Item total price updates. Subtotal in Ringkasan Pembayaran decreases accordingly.
Actual Result: Quantity reduces to 1 and subtotal recalculates correctly.

Test Scenario: Decrement item quantity from 1 (Item removal)
Precondition: Cart contains an item with quantity = 1.
Steps:
1. Tap the "-" button on the item.
2. If confirmation dialog appears, confirm removal.
Expected Result: Item is removed from the cart list. Subtotal decreases by item value. If cart becomes empty, empty state is displayed.
Actual Result: Item is successfully removed from cart list.

Test Scenario: Verify Empty Cart state display and CTA
Precondition: Cart contains 0 items.
Steps: 1. Open Cart page with empty cart (or delete all items).
Expected Result: Empty cart graphic is displayed with message ("Keranjangmu masih kosong") and a working CTA button "Mulai Belanja" redirecting to homepage.
Actual Result: Empty illustration and "Mulai Belanja" CTA button are displayed properly.

Test Scenario: Handle Out of Stock / Inactive item in Cart
Precondition: User has an item in cart that becomes out of stock in dark store.
Steps:
1. Open Cart page containing an out-of-stock item.
2. Observe item card state and checkout CTA button.
Expected Result: Item is greyed out with badge "Tidak dapat diproses". Subtotal excludes the unavailable item. Checkout button prompts user to remove unavailable item.
Actual Result: System flags unavailable item with "Tidak dapat diproses" and prevents invalid checkout.

Test Scenario: Add custom delivery notes to item/order
Precondition: Cart contains items; user is on Cart page.
Steps:
1. Click "Tambah Catatan" under item row or delivery section.
2. Type note: "Tolong pilihkan buah yang matang dan segar ya".
3. Click Save/Submit.
Expected Result: Note is saved and displayed beneath the item. Character counter enforces maximum character limit (e.g. 150 chars).
Actual Result: Note is displayed and persisted in order payload.

Test Scenario: Change Delivery Address ("Ganti Alamat")
Precondition: Default delivery address is currently selected.
Steps:
1. In "Tujuan Pengiriman" section, click "Ganti Alamat".
2. Select another saved address or enter new address pin.
3. Confirm selection.
Expected Result: Delivery destination updates. Nearest dark store hub inventory and delivery fee are re-calculated.
Actual Result: Address successfully changes and updates delivery parameters.

Test Scenario: Validate Address Not Covered warning alert
Precondition: User selects an address outside Astronauts active delivery zone.
Steps:
1. Click "Ganti Alamat".
2. Pick a location outside delivery radius.
3. Observe Cart page alert banner.
Expected Result: Warning banner appears: "Alamat ini jauh dari lokasimu saat ini. Cek lagi, ya." Checkout button "Lanjut ke pembayaran" is disabled.
Actual Result: Alert banner appears and checkout button is disabled.

Test Scenario: Verify Building / Apartment Lobby Delivery disclaimer
Precondition: User opens Cart page with delivery address set.
Steps: 1. Check delivery destination info text in Cart.
Expected Result: Informational note is clearly visible: "Khusus gedung, hanya bisa diantar sampai lobby" setting clear delivery expectations.
Actual Result: Notice is clearly displayed under the delivery address header.

Test Scenario: Apply valid promo code in Cart
Precondition: Cart subtotal meets minimum promo requirement (e.g. >= Rp 50.000).
Steps:
1. Click "Pilihan Promo" / "Lebih hemat pakai promo".
2. Enter promo code "ASTROHEMAT" or click eligible voucher.
3. Click "Terapkan".
Expected Result: Voucher is applied. Success toast appears. Discount line item appears in Ringkasan Pembayaran and total tagihan is deducted.
Actual Result: Promo applied successfully; discount deducted from total tagihan.

Test Scenario: Apply invalid or expired promo code
Precondition: User is on promo code input modal.
Steps:
1. Enter non-existent code "KODEPALSU999".
2. Click "Terapkan".
Expected Result: Inline error message appears ("Kode promo tidak valid atau telah berakhir"). Discount is not applied; bill remains unchanged.
Actual Result: Error message displayed; total bill is unaffected.

Test Scenario: Verify Service Fee breakdown pop-up modal
Precondition: Cart contains items and displays "Biaya Layanan" row in payment summary.
Steps:
1. Click info icon (i) next to "Biaya Layanan".
2. Inspect modal content.
Expected Result: Pop-up "Informasi Biaya Layanan" appears detailing Biaya Kemasan, Biaya Pembayaran, Total Biaya Layanan, and dismiss button "Mengerti".
Actual Result: Modal opens with itemized packaging and payment fees.

Test Scenario: Verify Free Shipping threshold dynamic discount
Precondition: Free shipping threshold is Rp 100.000.
Steps:
1. Add items totaling Rp 70.000 (shipping fee applied).
2. Increase item quantity so subtotal exceeds Rp 100.000.
3. Check shipping cost row.
Expected Result: Shipping fee is crossed out or displays "Free Ongkir" (Rp 0). Total tagihan excludes delivery fee.
Actual Result: Delivery fee becomes Free Ongkir upon passing threshold.

Test Scenario: Verify Saldo Astro / Refund Balance auto-deduction
Precondition: User account has positive Saldo Refund (e.g. Rp 20.000).
Steps:
1. Open Cart page.
2. Observe payment summary rows.
Expected Result: Row "Saldo Refund" appears with label "Saldo Astro otomatis digunakan", deducting Rp 20.000 from final bill amount.
Actual Result: Refund balance is automatically subtracted from total tagihan.

Test Scenario: Validate 18+ Age Restriction verification flow
Precondition: User adds age-restricted item (e.g. alcoholic beverage / tobacco product).
Steps:
1. Open Cart page with 18+ item.
2. Click "Lanjut ke pembayaran" without verified age profile.
Expected Result: Verification modal appears: "Khusus 18 tahun keatas! Silahkan terlebih dahulu update detail akun kamu" with CTA "Update Detail Akun". Checkout paused until DOB verified.
Actual Result: Confirmation dialog halts checkout and requests age verification.

Test Scenario: Verify Checkout CTA button enabled/disabled states
Precondition: User is on Cart page.
Steps:
1. Observe "Lanjut ke pembayaran" button when cart is empty vs when valid items exist.
2. Observe button state when delivery address is not covered.
Expected Result: Button is disabled (greyed out, unclickable) on empty or unserviceable cart; enabled (primary blue, clickable) when all conditions are valid.
Actual Result: CTA button correctly enables/disables based on cart validity.

Test Scenario: Verify mobile viewport responsiveness (375px & 430px)
Precondition: Browser in mobile responsive mode (iPhone SE 375px, iPhone 14 Pro Max 430px).
Steps:
1. Navigate through Cart page from header to footer.
2. Check button taps, sticky checkout footer, and horizontal scroll.
Expected Result: No horizontal scrollbar or broken layouts. Sticky checkout bar sits at bottom without overlapping items. Touch targets >= 44x44px.
Actual Result: Responsive layout conforms cleanly to mobile screen dimensions.

Test Scenario: Handle offline / network interruption during Cart action
Precondition: Cart page is open with items.
Steps:
1. Disable internet connection (offline mode).
2. Tap "+" to increase quantity or click "Lanjut ke pembayaran".
Expected Result: Application displays friendly toast: "Koneksi terputus, periksa internet kamu". Application does not crash; retains existing cart state.
Actual Result: Toast appears gracefully without data loss or application crash.

Test Scenario: Verify Homepage Search Bar input and suggestions
Precondition: User is on Astronauts homepage.
Steps:
1. Click on Search input bar.
2. Type "Susu UHT".
3. Press Enter or click search button.
Expected Result: Search bar accepts alphanumeric input. Redirects to search results page showing relevant milk products with active Add to Cart buttons.
Actual Result: Search query executes and returns relevant product listings.

Test Scenario: Verify Homepage Promotional Banners Carousel
Precondition: User is on Astronauts homepage.
Steps:
1. Observe top promo carousel banner.
2. Allow 4-5 seconds for auto-scroll or manually swipe left/right.
3. Click on active banner.
Expected Result: Carousel smoothly transitions between banners; pagination dots sync with active slide; clicking banner redirects to target promotional campaign.
Actual Result: Carousel transitions smoothly and links redirect correctly.

Test Scenario: Verify Category quick-access grid navigation
Precondition: User is on Astronauts homepage.
Steps:
1. Locate Category tiles section (Astro Goods, Astro Cafe, Sayur Segar, etc.).
2. Click on "Astro Goods" category tile.
Expected Result: Browser navigates to /c/astro-goods-2564; displays curated catalog filtered by Astro Goods items.
Actual Result: Navigates to correct category catalog page.

Test Scenario: Verify Bottom Navigation Bar tab switching
Precondition: User is on Astronauts web application.
Steps: 1. Click sequentially on bottom navigation items: Home -> Keranjang -> Transaksi -> Profil.
Expected Result: Active navigation tab highlights in blue (#246EE5); corresponding view/page loads seamlessly without breaking application state.
Actual Result: Bottom navigation tabs switch cleanly with correct active indicator.
